description: Email related environment variables. These variables are used to configure the email settings for the containers, such as SMTP server address, credentials, and ports. Make sure to update these variables according to your email service provider's configuration before using the docker-compose files.

Host related variables that will be used across the docker-compose files. These variables are specific to the host machine and can be used to configure various aspects of the containers, such as user permissions, and volume mounts. Make sure to update these variables according to your host machine's configuration before using the docker-compose files.
This file is used to store user preferences and configurations that are universal to the host machine and can be used across all the docker-compose files.

Network related environment variables. These variables are used to configure the network settings for the containers, such as IP addresses and ports. Make sure to update these variables according to your host machine's configuration before using the docker-compose files.
VPN related environment variables. These variables are used to configure the VPN settings for the containers, such as VPN server address, credentials, and protocols.
